constraints_found.constraint: Peanut allergy, including cross-contact (deal-breaker). Implied, never named.
constraints_found.source_line: Noted. Any stall with that tub, on the counter or tucked away in the back, I'll admire from across the aisle. The far end of the counter isn't far enough.

constraints_found.constraint: Vegetarian / meat-free (strict diet, deal-breaker). Implied through the tofu exchange.
constraints_found.source_line: tofu everything?? that sounds like my kind of row :) (supported by cyrus: 'Then wherever we land will have plenty of options for Mina.')

constraints_found.constraint: Light, clean food; no fried or heavy dishes (preference, costs a star)
constraints_found.source_line: speaking of which: it's way too warm tonight for anything heavy. i want a dinner that feels light and clean (and 'way out. i don't even want to stand next to one in this heat' re fryer stalls)

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: none stated; every venue is $, so price does not separate options

elimination.downtown_banyan_kitchen: Peanuts everywhere, roasted on site; fails Cyrus (deal-breaker).
elimination.night_market_stone_well: Peanut-free and light, but no meat-free options (fish sauce / dried shrimp in everything); fails Mina (deal-breaker).
elimination.night_market_twelve_bells: Peanut-safe and has meat-free items, but everything is fried and heavy; misses Brooke's light preference (-1 star).
elimination.night_market_plum_bridge: Peanut-safe, vegetarian options, light, but dim sum, not Vietnamese; misses the craving (-1 star).
elimination.night_market_red_thread: Peanut-safe, vegetarian options, light, but sushi, not Vietnamese; misses the craving (-1 star).
elimination.night_market_firefly_lane: Viet, no peanuts stocked anywhere (dips and oil included), vegetarian mushroom pho and tofu dishes, light and clean. Meets every constraint.

notes: Both deal-breakers are only implied. Cyrus never says 'allergy' and Mina never says 'vegetarian'. Cyrus's line is strong enough, and the 'far end of the counter' wording points to cross-contact. Mina's diet rests on her tofu excitement plus Cyrus's 'options for Mina' line. A player who reads those as enthusiasm rather than a diet could rank Stone Well level with Firefly Lane. Confirming the diet from earlier levels may be intended, but in this chat alone it is the weakest clue.

Firefly Lane's review says the son does homework 'at the far end of the counter', which echoes Cyrus's phrase. That reads as a deliberate red herring and is harmless because the second review clearly rules out peanuts.

Firefly Lane mentions fried shallots and 'frying oil', which might briefly make a player wonder about Brooke's no-fryer wish. The first review settles it ('clean broth', 'feeling fresh instead of stuffed').
Banyan Kitchen's id starts with 'downtown_' even though it is a night-market cart. Its review explains this (a downtown lunch counter's night cart). I did not use the id in deciding.
Twelve Bells has a near-miss: it is safe and has meat-free options, but it is all fried. Plum Bridge and Red Thread are good off-cuisine decoys. Overall the puzzle feels fair.
